trial_court: 1st Addl. Family Judge at Bangalore, M.C.No.1785/2013
case_name: Sri T Shreedhar vs Smt C Rajeshwari
facts_of_case: The parties are residing separately due to disputes in their marital life. The petitioner seeks dissolution of marriage under Section 13(1)(ia) of the Hindu Marriage Act. The respondent sought maintenance and litigation expenses. The trial court directed payment of Rs.5,000/- per month towards maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: Maintenance cannot be refused merely on the ground that the financial condition of the husband is not good.
legal_principles.held: It is held therein that the maintenance cannot be refused merely on the ground that the financial condition of the husband is not good.
cited_cases: Smt.Padmavathi and others vs. C.Lakshminarayana (AIR 2002 Kar 424)

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to prove their income and financial condition.
legal_principles.held: No materials were produced before the Court below. In fact the Court below itself has arrived at the conclusion that such contention relating to the income is improbable

outcome.final_order: The final order quashed the trial court's order directing payment of maintenance.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
